description: Word-level golden set for manual translation-quality review (fork issue #3, spec issue #1 §10.5). Each case is evaluated by hand against a live LLM engine whenever the word prompt or engine changes: the popover's contextual translation must match expectedSense (not the distractor). Target: ≥90% of cases pass. Not run in CI — requires a configured provider.
